headline: Why am I still working when the money should have come by now?
note: generated from REVIEW-new-voice.md — not a wired draft

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see them, and your hand found the worker of the three.
Look at his hands. Both are busy, and neither has stopped.
You asked why you're still working when the money should have come. What catches me is that both of those hands are at work.
The part that doesn't fit is that nothing has come through. And you're the one still at it.
Something has a firm hold on this. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's got hold of it…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Nothing showed which was which, and you took the one held at one ankle.
Look at the rope. One ankle holds him, and nothing else does.
You asked why you're still working when the money should have come. What holds my eye is the one rope, and where it ends.
Still, nothing has come through. And you're the one carrying on regardless.
Something sits between the work and the pay, right in that gap. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and you chose the one already stepping out.
Look at his feet. One is lifted, and the other hasn't caught up.
You asked why you're still working when the money should have come. What I keep looking at is a step already made.
But nothing has come through. And you're still the one asking why.

Let me look closer at what's there…
